device.name: Factor-World Sawyer nut assembly (Meta-World assembly-v2, simulated)

facts.text: The repository provides MetaWorld environments with factors of variation including arm position, camera position, floor texture, lighting, object position, object size, object texture, table position, table texture and distractor objects
The make_wrapped_env factory selects the goal-hidden class for env_name unless observe_goal is true
The assembly-v2 environment name is registered to the SawyerNutAssemblyEnvV2 class
SawyerNutAssemblyEnvV2 uses the MJCF model sawyer_xyz/sawyer_assembly_peg.xml
The environment action space is a Box of four elements, each from -1 to +1
A step applies action[:3] as a mocap hand displacement through set_xyz_action and action[-1] as the two gripper actuator commands [action[-1], -action[-1]]
set_xyz_action clips the action to -1..1, scales it by action_scale and clips the mocap position to mocap_low..mocap_high
SawyerXYZEnv defaults frame_skip to 5
SawyerXYZEnv defaults action_scale to 1/100
MujocoEnv.dt is model.opt.timestep times frame_skip
The MJCF basic scene sets the physics timestep to 0.0025 s
The assembly model has two position actuators, r_close and l_close, with ctrlrange -1 to +1, and a weld equality attaches the mocap body to the hand
MujocoEnv loads the model with mujoco_py.load_model_from_path and creates a mujoco_py.MjSim
SawyerXYZEnv sets max_path_length to 500
A step ends the episode when info['success'] is true or curr_path_length reaches max_path_length
The step returns the observation dictionary, info['success'] as the reward, the done flag and the info dictionary
The v2 observation is a 39-element flat proprio array made of 18 current elements, 18 previous elements and a 3-element goal, and the image is None unless get_image_obs is set
The proprio observation is cast to np.float32
Without images the observation space is a Dict with a single proprio Box
SawyerXYZEnv.reset resets curr_path_length to 0 and calls the base reset
MujocoEnv.reset calls sim.reset and reset_model and returns the observation reset_model produced
The assembly reset_model resets the hand, sets the target to the goal, places the object and the peg, and returns the observation
The goal-hidden class sets _set_task_called to True in its constructor, so the configured task does not need an external set_task before reset
The factor wrapper generates a model XML that includes factors/factors_train.xml or factors/factors_eval.xml, so factors change the model file
The project pins python 3.8, mujoco_py >=2.1,<2.2 and gym 0.25.1

determinism.notes: The configured task has random_init false (envs/sawyer_xyz_env.py:107 and :135), so its reset_model takes fixed start positions and does not draw from the RNG; the legacy seed() is recorded by the bridge but does not select a different start.  The package's fake is deterministic and repeats exactly for any seed.

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in for the MuJoCo task: it does not load the MJCF model, does not run mujoco_py, and resolves no contacts, mocap weld, gripper actuators, object physics, collision or assembly reward, so trajectories, success and grasp state are not modelled

the fake returns the 39-element proprio list of Python floats with placeholder object, goal and previous-frame values; upstream returns a numpy float32 array whose values are MuJoCo site and body positions
the fake does not render images: image is None, matching the class default get_image_obs false (envs/sawyer_xyz_env.py:108); the 84x84 camera path the factory requests by default is not served

the factor wrappers for arm, camera, floor texture, lighting, object, table and distractor factors are not served: they generate a different MJCF XML from factors_train.xml or factors_eval.xml (envs/factors/utils.py:61-72), and this package serves the base assembly-v2 class
the card's class entry symbol is SawyerNutAssemblyEnvV2; the factory builds a goal-hidden subclass that sets _set_task_called (envs/env_dict.py:348-355), and the fake models that configured task
MuJoCo 2.1, mujoco_py and gym are not installed where the gate runs (conda_env.yml:19-46), so no trajectory or observation was compared with the upstream environment
snapshot_restore is false: the class has set_state but no get_state pair, and the Gymnasium bridge offers snapshots only when both exist
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and one tick advances the environment by 12.5 ms of simulated time only (0.0025 s timestep times frame_skip 5)
the fake's action path does not clip the hand to the task's hand_low/hand_high; it applies the normalised first three elements at action_scale 1/100 without a collision or joint-limit model

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation stays readable
